drafter.message_to_opposing_counsel: Thank you. Subject to client approval and definitive agreement, we counter with a $400,000 annual base salary, a 40% target annual bonus, and 12 months of base salary plus one annual target bonus upon termination without Cause or resignation for Good Reason. We propose up to 12 months of continued health coverage support, subject to applicable law and earlier eligibility for comparable employer coverage. Cash severance would not be subject to mitigation or offset, but would require an effective release. We have proposed narrow Cause and Good Reason definitions with appropriate cure rights. We can proceed without a post-employment noncompete, while preserving appropriate confidentiality and intellectual-property protections. Equity remains open. Please confirm the Executive's legal name, work location, and proposed governing law. These edits are negotiating proposals, not an acceptance or binding commitment.

edits.text: 2. COMPENSATION. The Executive shall receive an annual base salary of USD 400,000, payable in accordance with the Company's regular payroll practices and subject to applicable withholding. The Executive shall be eligible for an annual performance bonus with a target of 40% of annual base salary, with actual payment dependent on achievement of performance objectives established by the Board and communicated to the Executive. Performance objectives, payment timing, proration, and treatment on termination remain to be agreed. The Executive shall be eligible to participate in employee benefit plans generally available to similarly situated executives, subject to their terms. Equity awards, if any, and all related terms remain subject to separate express agreement.

3. SEVERANCE. If the Company terminates the Executive's employment without Cause or the Executive resigns for Good Reason, the Executive shall, subject to execution and nonrevocation of a mutually acceptable release of claims, receive cash severance equal to 12 months of then-current base salary plus one annual target bonus at the rate in effect immediately before termination. Cash severance shall not be subject to mitigation or offset for subsequent earnings. Subject to timely election of available continuation coverage, the Company shall provide health coverage support for the Executive and eligible dependents at the same employer contribution level as immediately before termination for up to 12 months, ending earlier upon eligibility for comparable coverage through another employer. The mechanism for that support remains subject to applicable law and plan terms. Cause means fraud, embezzlement, or misappropriation involving the Company; conviction of or plea of guilty or no contest to a felony involving dishonesty; willful misconduct causing material harm to the Company; or a material breach of this Agreement or willful continued failure to perform material duties after written notice and a 30-day opportunity to cure, to the extent curable. Good Reason means, without the Executive's written consent, a material reduction in base salary or target bonus opportunity, a material diminution of duties or authority, relocation of the principal work location by more than 50 miles, or a material breach of this Agreement by the Company. Good Reason requires written notice within 60 days after the event, a 30-day opportunity for the Company to cure, and resignation within 30 days after expiration of the cure period if uncured. Accrued compensation and vested benefits shall be payable independently of the release in accordance with applicable law and plan terms. Severance payment timing, release procedures, applicable tax-compliance provisions, and treatment of outstanding incentive and equity awards remain to be agreed.

4. RESTRICTIVE COVENANTS. No post-employment noncompetition covenant is proposed. Appropriate provisions addressing protection of confidential information, assignment of work-related intellectual property, and return of Company property remain to be agreed following confirmation of the Executive's work location and applicable law. Any such provisions shall preserve legally protected disclosures, reporting, and other protected activity.

Equity, objective bonus criteria and termination-year proration, release and payment mechanics remain to be agreed; we will confirm the Executive’s legal name, work location, and proposed governing law after obtaining client instructions.
